title: Add `__meta_azure_machine_state` to `azure_sd_config`
body:
### Proposal

Currently there is no option to filter out stopped machines on Azure, Prometheus scrapes all machines. It would be nice to have something like `__meta_azure_machine_state`, similar to AWS `__meta_ec2_instance_state` to be able to keep only running machines.

Or I missed something and there is such option or workaround?
